You will help manage and improve site security operations across our data centers, collaborating with security vendors and internal teams to uphold the highest standards of physical security. Basic qualifications include 2+ years overseeing security operations and working with security vendors.

jobs.title: Data Center Security Officer I
jobs.company: NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc.
jobs.description:
NTT Global Data Centers Americas, Inc. is seeking an on-site Security Officer L1 to protect personnel and property at a data center. You will manage access control, monitor CCTV, respond to incidents, and complete written reports in a client-facing role.

The role requires strong observation and communication skills, the ability to multi-task, and adherence to security procedures. A valid driver’s license and ability to work a 1pm-7pm shift midweek is essential.
